canonicalTerms.runtimeSurface: A concrete runtime path used to discover, trust, load, mount, update, and unmount a micro-vertical.
canonicalTerms.parityClaim: A claim that the candidate runtime surface produces equivalent host-visible behavior to the canonical baseline for a named scenario.
canonicalTerms.parityEvidence: Machine-readable and reviewer-readable artifacts proving a parity claim across required scenarios.
canonicalTerms.knownNonEquivalence: A runtime behavior that is intentionally different and must not be hidden behind a generic parity pass.
canonicalTerms.trustDecision: The host decision about whether a remote artifact is allowed to proceed past trust gates.
canonicalTerms.compatibilityDecision: The host decision about whether a remote artifact is compatible with the host runtime contract.
canonicalTerms.fallback: A deterministic host action that avoids mounting or keeps the shell stable when a remote cannot satisfy trust, compatibility, or runtime lifecycle requirements.

trustDecisions.description: Remote artifact satisfies configured origin, integrity, attestation, and isolation policy.
Remote artifact violates a non-blocking policy in warn mode and may continue with telemetry.
Remote artifact violates a strict trust policy and must not be loaded or mounted.
Remote artifact lacks enough trust metadata to make an allow decision in strict mode.

compatibilityDecisions.description: Required runtime digest, manifest fields, entry shape, and lifecycle contract match the host policy.
Remote may continue through a documented degradation path with explicit telemetry and evidence.
Remote conflicts with host compatibility policy and must enter fallback instead of mounting.
Remote lacks enough compatibility metadata to proceed in strict mode.

knownNonEquivalences.title: Remote loading model
knownNonEquivalences.description: Garfish application loading and Module Federation remote/container loading are not equivalent implementation models.

knownNonEquivalences.title: Shared dependency negotiation
knownNonEquivalences.description: Module Federation share-scope negotiation is not equivalent to Garfish application-level dependency isolation.

knownNonEquivalences.title: Sandbox and isolation semantics
knownNonEquivalences.description: Garfish sandbox behavior and Module Federation execution isolation do not provide identical side-effect boundaries.

knownNonEquivalences.title: Lifecycle entry shape
knownNonEquivalences.description: Garfish provider lifecycle exports and Module Federation container/module exports are different entry contracts.

knownNonEquivalences.title: SSR entry shape
knownNonEquivalences.description: App-level SSR server/client entry contracts must be proven separately for the candidate runtime.

knownNonEquivalences.title: Asset and cache invalidation
knownNonEquivalences.description: Manifest revalidation and version-pinned remote entry caching may use different artifact boundaries.

knownNonEquivalences.title: Prefetch and routing timing
knownNonEquivalences.description: Route discovery, prefetch timing, and mount timing may differ even when final rendered output matches.

knownNonEquivalences.title: Style and global side effects
knownNonEquivalences.description: CSS, global variables, and runtime singleton side effects must be compared explicitly.

knownNonEquivalences.title: Telemetry timing
knownNonEquivalences.description: Equivalent telemetry envelopes do not imply identical timestamp ordering or span boundaries.

requiredBeforeMarkingModuleFederationCan: complete parity evidence for every required scenario category
explicit disposition for every known non-equivalence
fallback telemetry samples for every blocking fallback reason exercised by the scenario matrix
reviewed release-candidate gate artifact tied to a commit SHA
canonicalityRules.failedOrMissingEvidenceDecision: module-federation remains candidate and garfish remains canonical baseline
